description: Selectors, toolchain pins, reproduction commands and independent checks from which the seal tool builds the frozen input list of the independent Assurance. The product root is enumerated from Git; the runtime-link evidence root is enumerated only under the paths its obligation ledger cites. This template describes current-completion Assurance. Final frozen-source clean Assurance requires a separately frozen specification and seal whose runtime-link-kernel-replay entry has coldReplay true and executes every sealed kernel command without recorded heaps.

bundles.description: Isabelle theories, sessions and dependency locks that define the abstract model, the transaction relation and the runtime bridge constants.
Kernel schema and generated ABI, receipt schema, conformance vectors and the normative proposal and profile documents.
Final Solidity sources of the three profiles, their tests and symbolic harnesses, and the compiler configuration.
Recorded runtime identities, the release manifest, the deterministic build receipt, the runtime binding and the prepared code identity document that the Assurance compares against a fresh build.
Conditional evidence ledgers, the central closure artifacts, the prepared tail documents and the SDK that consumes the receipt format.
Verification scripts and continuous-integration workflows that the reproduction commands run.
The runtime-link obligation ledger and, for every kernel run it cites, the recorded result, the recorded command and the session sources of every evidence directory that command loads.
Every other tracked file of the product commit, so that the whole release tree is frozen.

reproduction.purpose: Compile the sealed sources with the pinned compiler.
reproduction.passCriterion: Exit code 0, and every runtime identity recomputed by the tail preparation code identity check equals the sealed code identity document.

reproduction.purpose: Run the unit, fuzz, invariant and pinned upstream integration tests of the three profiles.
reproduction.command: python3 scripts/prepare-trex-integration.py && FOUNDRY_FUZZ_RUNS=256 FOUNDRY_INVARIANT_RUNS=256 FOUNDRY_INVARIANT_DEPTH=500 forge test -vv
reproduction.passCriterion: Exit code 0 with no skipped suite.

reproduction.purpose: Recompute every prepared tail document from the sealed sources and compiled artifacts.
reproduction.passCriterion: Exit code 0: every generated document is byte-identical to its sealed copy.

reproduction.purpose: Run the conditional evidence verifiers of the product.

Rehash the private certificate registry and its locator file, rebuild the registry in closure mode from the sealed evidence with the sealed tool, and compare it with the sealed registry and its public record. No prover or kernel session is rerun.

Rehash the private route disposition test receipt, its forge report, the malformed probe receipt and the stored route inventory, recompute the test receipt from the forge report, rebuild the inventory in closure mode with the sealed tool and compare it with the stored inventory and its public record. Foundry is not rerun.

Rehash the private typed failure probe, mutant, frozen build and load scan records and the seven compiled artifacts, recompute every probe and mutant receipt from its forge report and the load scan from the compiled artifacts, and compare them with the stored records and the public record. Neither Foundry nor the compiler is rerun.

Rehash the private call frame report and the stored proof graphs, node files, boundary records and node inventories of the 42 registered requests outside canonical form, recompute the report with the sealed tool and compare it with the stored report and the public record. No prover, symbolic execution or kernel session is rerun.

Rehash the stored build information and the private reflection scan report, rerun the sealed scan tool on the stored build information against the sealed product tree and compare the result with the stored report and the public record. The compiler is not rerun.
Replay the product proof sessions without saved heaps or databases, after installing the pinned Isabelle archive, AFP entry and formal foundation as the proof workflow does.
reproduction.passCriterion: Every declared session builds, and each proof audit export reports status PASS with oracle_dependency_count 0.

reproduction.purpose: For current-completion Assurance, verify all sealed runtime-link results and native freshness, replay changed units and their affected consumers, and replay gate checks and selected top-level kernel consumers.
reproduction.command: Verify hashes, source bytes, tool pins, parent lineage, oracle and skip status, and native freshness of every sealed runtime-link result. Replay each changed unit and its affected consumers, all gate checks, and the explicitly selected top-level kernel consumers. Record the selection and all five reuse conditions for every reused unit.
reproduction.passCriterion: Every required unit is covered by either a successful replay or a valid reused kernel result under all five reuse conditions; all declared positive, negative, consumer and export checks pass. Each replay exits 0 with the expected status and exact theory identities.

reproduction.purpose: Confirm that the inputs read by the Assurance are exactly the sealed inputs.
reproduction.passCriterion: Status PASS_ASSURANCE_INPUT_SEAL_VERIFIED before and after the Assurance run.

assuranceChecks.question: Can the command, state and receipt observables be reconstructed from the frozen schema, requirements and vectors alone, without reading the implementation?
procedure: Rebuild every conformance vector command, its calldata and its expected receipt from the kernel schema and the generated ABI only.
Rebuild the malformed input catalog from the kernel ABI and the generated bridge constants and compare it with the sealed catalog.
Compare the reconstruction with the sealed vectors and the sealed independent reproduction receipt.
assuranceChecks.passCriterion: Every reconstructed observable equals the sealed one.
assuranceChecks.onFailure: Return to Building. The assessor records the difference and never edits a sealed file.

assuranceChecks.question: Does every route, state write, event and theorem of the final artifacts belong to an obligation row or to a declared runtime-only item?
procedure: Enumerate every public and external selector of every profile runtime from a fresh build and compare it with the sealed route inventory.
Enumerate every storage variable and emitted event of the profile runtimes and compare them with the sealed state and receipt crosswalk.
Enumerate every ledger row and every cited theorem and report orphan theorems, orphan code, unmapped routes and unused lifecycle states.
assuranceChecks.passCriterion: No unmapped route, orphan state write, orphan theorem or unclassified selector remains.
assuranceChecks.onFailure: Return to Building with the list of orphans.

assuranceChecks.question: Does removing or weakening each load-bearing consumer actually break the claim that depends on it?
procedure: Replay every certificate-removal negative and every consumer-removal negative that the ledger cites.
Rerun the declared mutation campaign and the semantic consumer removals of the product.
For the malformed rows, replay the malformed probe with its checks disabled one at a time and confirm that the probe fails.
assuranceChecks.passCriterion: Every negative fails at the claimed consumer and at no earlier unrelated step.
assuranceChecks.onFailure: Return to Building with the surviving negative.

assuranceChecks.question: Do the numbers, hashes and statuses of the central closure artifact follow from the actual files, build exits and runtime outputs?
procedure: Rebuild the obligation ledger from the sealed evidence and compare every row status, count and hash.

Recompute the certificate registry from the sealed locator file and evidence, require it to equal the sealed registry byte for byte, and confirm that the public registry record, including the executed code of every certificate and the records that consumed every recorded world, follows from it.
Recompute the central closure counts and confirm that no row is closed by a human-written table alone.
assuranceChecks.passCriterion: Every recomputed number, hash and status equals the sealed artifact, and current mandatory rows are zero only if the recomputation says so.
assuranceChecks.onFailure: Return to Building. A mismatch is never resolved by editing the expected value.

reuse.policy: Validated earlier results may be reused only as the incremental verification standard allows; a cache hit is never a check result, and the union of new and reused checks must cover the whole declared scope.
conditions: Input identity: sources, transitive dependencies, generated inputs, statements and assumptions of the reused unit equal the sealed ones.
Tool identity: checker and compiler versions, dependency locks, build options and platform equal the sealed pins; Windows and Linux heaps are never exchanged.
Materialization: the reused heap, database, proof object or checked certificate is present and its recorded integrity hash matches.
Provenance: the producing repository, commit, run and permission of the reused state are recorded and trusted for the claim.
Current consumption: the native checker confirms freshness against the sealed sources and the final consumer reads the reused result.
coldReplayRequiredFor: an explicitly selected final frozen-source clean runtime-link replay
any release or final frozen-source clean Assurance claim
any toolchain or dependency pin change

exclusions: Conclusions, handoffs, status summaries and chat reports of the Building sessions are not Assurance inputs.
The assessor never edits a sealed file; any needed change returns the work to Building and requires a new seal.
A seal with status TEMPLATE_DRY_RUN is a format exercise and is never an Assurance input.
A participant of any Building session of this runtime link does not act as the independent assessor.
